description: PreToolUse Write|Edit -> format_pre: every supported language is formatted BEFORE the write and handed back via updatedInput — the prettier languages (jsts/json/yaml/markdown/css/scss/less/html/vue/graphql/shell/java/php) in-process with the prettier and the java/php/shell plugins bundled into this plugin's MCP server, kotlin/python/go/rust by feeding the content on stdin to the first CLI formatter on PATH (ktlint/ktfmt, ruff/black, goimports/gofmt, rustfmt). The one hook, the one tool: nothing runs after the write.
